_source: Transcrit du plan papier de l'user (collé en chat). Dimensions ESTIMÉES à l'échelle du lit 140×190 — remplacer par les cotes réelles si dispo.

global.tech: architectural interior photography, magazine quality (Dezeen, AD), ultra-photoreal, soft natural daylight, straight verticals, 24mm wide-angle

rooms.name: Salon / Séjour / Cuisine
rooms.dimensions: open-plan L-shape, approx 8.50 × 6.00 m, ~48 m², 2.50 m ceiling
rooms.layout: large open living-dining-kitchen; full-height windows with roller shutters on the east and south walls, kitchen along the north-west wall (sink under a window, cooktop and counter), opening onto the hall to the west
rooms.placement: low modular sofa facing the south windows, round dining table with 4 chairs near the kitchen, kitchen island/counter against north wall, NO clutter
rooms.viewpoint: wide-angle 24mm shot from the west corner looking east toward the big windows, eye-level ~1.6 m, straight verticals
rooms.floor: european white-oak engineered planks, matte oil finish
rooms.lighting: soft natural daylight flooding from south/east windows, discreet linear cove light
rooms.furniture: low oak-framed linen sofa, round oak dining table with 4 wishbone chairs, minimalist sage-green kitchen cabinetry with stone counter
rooms.colors: Farrow & Ball Cornforth White, warm neutrals, terracotta accents, sage green kitchen
rooms.extra: potted olive tree by the window, dried branches in a stone pot

rooms.name: Chambre 1
rooms.dimensions: rectangular, approx 3.50 × 3.40 m, ~12 m², 2.50 m ceiling
rooms.layout: window with roller shutter on the south wall, door to the hall on the north wall, built-in wardrobe on the east wall
rooms.placement: double bed (140×190) centred against the west wall, wardrobe on the east wall. NO desk, NO sofa
rooms.viewpoint: frontal wide-angle shot facing the bed against the west wall, eye-level ~1.6 m, straight verticals
rooms.floor: european white-oak engineered planks, matte oil finish
rooms.lighting: soft natural daylight, two minimalist pendant bedside sconces
rooms.furniture: double bed with solid light-oak frame visible (~35 cm tall), full-height oak wardrobe, two small bedside tables
rooms.colors: warm neutrals, linen bedding, terracotta accent cushion
rooms.extra: single abstract earth-tone canvas above the bed

rooms.name: Chambre 2
rooms.dimensions: rectangular, approx 3.30 × 3.20 m, ~10.5 m², 2.50 m ceiling
rooms.layout: window on the north wall, small wardrobe/placard with window on the west wall, door to the corridor (DGT) on the south wall
rooms.placement: double bed (140×190) against the east wall, wardrobe on the west wall. NO desk, NO double sofa
rooms.viewpoint: frontal wide-angle shot facing the bed against the east wall, eye-level ~1.6 m, straight verticals
rooms.floor: european white-oak engineered planks, matte oil finish
rooms.lighting: soft natural daylight from the north window, one drum-shade pendant
rooms.furniture: double bed with solid light-oak frame visible (~35 cm tall), light-oak wardrobe, one bedside table
rooms.colors: warm neutrals, linen bedding, muted sage accent
rooms.extra: woven knit ottoman, small potted plant

rooms.name: Chambre 3
rooms.dimensions: rectangular, approx 3.30 × 3.20 m, ~10.5 m², 2.50 m ceiling
rooms.layout: window with roller shutter on the north wall, door to the corridor on the south wall, wardrobe on the east wall
rooms.placement: double bed (140×190) against the north wall under the window, wardrobe on the east wall. NO desk, NO bunk
rooms.viewpoint: frontal wide-angle shot facing the bed under the north window, eye-level ~1.6 m, straight verticals
rooms.floor: european white-oak engineered planks, matte oil finish
rooms.lighting: soft natural daylight, one minimalist drop pendant
rooms.furniture: double bed with solid light-oak frame visible (~35 cm tall), light-oak wardrobe, one bedside table
rooms.colors: warm neutrals, linen bedding, terracotta accent
rooms.extra: dried branch in a ceramic vase

rooms.name: Salle de bain
rooms.dimensions: rectangular, approx 2.80 × 2.40 m, ~6.7 m², 2.50 m ceiling
rooms.layout: window on the west wall, freestanding bathtub against the west wall under the window, double vanity along the south wall, door on the east wall
rooms.placement: freestanding oval bathtub under the west window, double washbasin vanity on the south wall. NO toilet (separate WC)
rooms.viewpoint: wide-angle shot from the door looking toward the bathtub and window, eye-level ~1.6 m, straight verticals
rooms.floor: honed travertine large-format tiles, warm putty
rooms.walls: lime plaster, hand-troweled, warm white, travertine splashback
rooms.lighting: soft natural daylight from the window, warm LED niche strip
rooms.furniture: freestanding matte-white resin bathtub, floating oak double vanity with stone top, oval brass-framed mirror
rooms.colors: warm putty travertine, oak, brushed brass fittings
rooms.extra: stacked linen towels, small potted olive branch

rooms.name: WC
rooms.dimensions: small, approx 1.40 × 1.10 m, ~1.5 m², 2.50 m ceiling
rooms.layout: wall-hung toilet against the west wall, door on the east wall
rooms.placement: wall-hung WC against the west wall, small corner basin. NOTHING else
rooms.viewpoint: frontal wide-angle shot facing the toilet wall, eye-level ~1.4 m, straight verticals
rooms.walls: lime plaster warm white, half-height oak panelling
rooms.furniture: wall-hung WC, slim oak shelf, small framed print
rooms.extra: single dried stem in a small vase

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.layout: entry hall connecting the porch (south) to the open living area (east) and the bedroom corridor (north)
rooms.placement: oak console table against one wall, oak-framed mirror above it, slatted oak bench. NO heavy furniture
rooms.viewpoint: wide-angle shot from the entrance looking in, eye-level ~1.6 m, straight verticals
rooms.floor: european white-oak engineered planks, matte oil finish
rooms.lighting: soft natural daylight, warm wall sconce
rooms.furniture: solid oak console / side table, oak-framed wall mirror, low oak slatted bench
rooms.extra: woven basket, ceramic vase with dried branches

rooms.name: Cellier
rooms.dimensions: rectangular, approx 2.60 × 2.20 m, ~5.7 m², 2.50 m ceiling
rooms.layout: utility room off the hall; washing machine and storage along the walls, heat-pump unit
rooms.placement: stacked washer/dryer against one wall, floor-to-ceiling storage cabinets, worktop
rooms.viewpoint: wide-angle shot from the door, eye-level ~1.6 m, straight verticals
rooms.furniture: full-height light-oak storage cabinetry, worktop with stone top, stacked laundry appliances
rooms.extra: woven baskets on shelves, NO clutter
